cohort: 70 pregnant patients with diabetes receiving care at a tertiary care center in Ahmedabad, India between July 2020 and June 2021.
finding: Increasing gravidity, age, and past history of gestational diabetes were identified as risk factors for adverse fetomaternal outcomes in pregnancies complicated by diabetes, with outcomes including polyhydramnios (44%), uteroplacental insufficiency (8%), intrauterine death (6%), and perinatal mortality (6%), and higher rates of cesarean delivery (48%).
